diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed initial failure of public success criteria: lab connectivity to external1 was already broken for several nodes and user1 throughput measured near zero. Read path-related config and found no usable safe ANI-supported way to install selective Linux tc filters on wan1; preflight rejected the needed u32 matcher. Tested one alternate hypothesis on leaf2 external next hops, but validation worsened and showed user1 lost external reachability entirely, so I rolled that change back successfully. Final state: no persistent config changes remain from my actions, public success criteria still fail, and no safe repair for the required throughput guarantee was found with the allowed interfaces.
diagnosis.reference: Sustained UDP cross traffic of 15 Mbit/s from guest1 floods the 10 Mbit/s link through wan1 (eth2), and nothing on that edge protects the assured class 10 for user1 to external1.
